name: B2B software
summary: Anthropic's customer-support plugin, connector defaults for HubSpot, Google Workspace, Slack, Zendesk and product-usage data, and the typical customer-success tasks for a B2B software company.

anthropic_starting_points.name: customer-support
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adapt. Five skills, no separate commands, agents or hooks; eight connectors in .mcp.json. Vendor a reviewed copy (reviewed at commit e91a134): cut each body under the kit's 150 lines, descriptions under 200 characters, drop argument-hint, and keep only the connectors the customer runs. ticket-triage and kb-article are skipped.

anthropic_starting_points.name: customer-escalation
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adapt, for C5. Point it at Zendesk and HubSpot, use the customer's escalation tiers and targets, and post to Slack only after a person approves.

anthropic_starting_points.name: draft-response
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adapt, for C3 and C4. Add the customer's tone, signature and renewal and follow-up templates. Keep it draft-only.

anthropic_starting_points.name: customer-research
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adapt. Keep the source ranking; limit it to connected systems, with web search only for public product facts.

anthropic_starting_points.name: sales
anthropic_starting_points.note: Reference. Its account-context, call-prep, renewal-radar, customer-health, call-summary and log-activity skills match C1 to C4. Not reviewed on page 18; review it before taking any skill from it.

connector_defaults.how: The HubSpot directory connector (mcp.hubspot.com/anthropic); an Owner adds it on Team and Enterprise. Super Admins and users with App Marketplace access permissions can connect it without prior app approval; for all other users a Super Admin approves it first and, while approving, selects the data permissions it may reach and who in the account can install it. With HubSpot's Sensitive Data settings on, a Super Admin can grant the connector read-only access to Sensitive Data properties and engagements during installation or reauthentication, and the user also needs the matching CRM object or property-level permissions. HubSpot recommends setting write tools to Needs approval.
connector_defaults.identity: Per user, via OAuth: each user signs in with their own HubSpot account, within the user's HubSpot permissions.

connector_defaults.how: The Google Drive directory connector, built and run by Google; an Owner adds it on Team and Enterprise. It searches, reads and creates files; the help-center article adds sharing, moving and trashing files, and the listing names share_file and trash_file among its tools. (Our recommendation) set each of those tools to Blocked or Needs approval. Shared-drive support is unverified.
connector_defaults.identity: Per user, via OAuth; each member connects their own Google account.

connector_defaults.how: The Gmail directory connector; an Owner or Primary Owner enables it on Team and Enterprise. The sources conflict over its write tools: the help-center article and the listing name send, reply and forward tools, and the connector page says it only reads. Set every write tool to Blocked or Needs approval, and plan the task on reads until the Google Workspace runbook's write test shows the tools in the customer's org.
connector_defaults.identity: Per user, via OAuth with the user's own Google account.

connector_defaults.how: The Google Calendar directory connector; an Owner or Primary Owner enables it on Team and Enterprise. The sources conflict over its write tools: the help-center article and the listing name tools that create, update and delete events, and the connector page says it only reads. Set every write tool to Blocked or Needs approval, and plan the task on reads until the Google Workspace runbook's write test shows the tools in the customer's org.
connector_defaults.identity: Per user, via OAuth with the user's own Google account.

connector_defaults.how: The Slack directory connector (Team and Enterprise; the Claude in Slack app installed first); an Owner enables it. Its listing names slack_send_message, slack_create_canvas and slack_update_canvas beside its search and read tools, while its connector page documents only search. The Slack MCP server can send and schedule messages.
connector_defaults.identity: Per user: each member connects their own account.

connector_defaults.how: Zendesk's External AI connection (early access), https://<subdomain>.zendesk.com/mcp, added by an Owner as a custom connector. A Zendesk admin creates the connection and limits it to agent groups. Zendesk's pages conflict over whether it asks a person before each change, so don't count on Zendesk asking, and set each write tool to Needs approval in Claude.
connector_defaults.identity: Per user, via OAuth: each user authorizes their own Zendesk account. Whether no call ever runs as a shared identity is unverified.

connector_defaults.how: Our own MCP server, read-only, returning aggregates. On Team there is no MCP tunnel: the server must be reachable from Anthropic's IP range, or the agent runs inside the network.
connector_defaults.identity: Set by the server we build: OAuth 2.1; per user through the customer's identity provider (our recommendation).
